dedupe_keys.name: aerodb weekly world airport csv and json exports

description: AeroDB publishes airport reference tables as CSV and JSON in a public GitHub repository. The README says the exports come from its own aviation-data API and are refreshed weekly; the tree shows both data formats and an update workflow. Repository metadata declares the Unlicense, and the project describes the export as free. Coverage is worldwide airport reference information, with the precise inclusion rule, field completeness and latest data timestamp not verified from the export payload. The own AeroDB landing page opened, but did not independently confirm every airport count or the weekly run. This collection is a distinct maintained provider export alongside data-ourairports, which offers crowd-maintained airport records, and data-airportsdata, which packages location and timezone reference fields. Simulation use includes assigning airport nodes or matching aviation datasets by identifier after checking schema and coordinate quality. The weekly claim refers to the publisher’s workflow, not a verified freshness measurement in this review. No CSV or JSON rows, API response or update job was inspected.
licence: Unlicense for repository data and code, as reported by GitHub metadata.
